cases.title: DNS Server is stopped
cases.summary: A configured critical service is recorded as stopped. Its required-running policy is explicit. The failure cause is not established.

evidence.title: Service state
evidence.detail: Service: DNS Server; configured expected state: running.

evidence.title: Service policy
evidence.detail: The demo policy explicitly marks this service as required. Other stopped services are not treated as failures.

nextSteps: Confirm this service is expected to be running on this endpoint.
Inspect the service state, last exit code and relevant bounded log evidence.
Check recent configuration and dependency changes.
Document the finding. Any restart requires separate operator approval.

timeline.title: Rule matched
timeline.detail: service.required_stopped.v1 evaluated against explicitly synthetic observations. No automated action ran.

cases.title: Storage pressure on system volume
cases.summary: The fixture system volume is 94.6% used, above the 90% rule threshold. This establishes capacity pressure, not hardware failure or its cause.

evidence.title: System volume usage
evidence.detail: Measured used-capacity ratio; available space should be confirmed before any cleanup.

nextSteps: Verify the affected local volume and available capacity.
Compare the last samples and confirm whether growth is continuing.
Check approved application retention settings with the owner.
Propose a scoped cleanup; do not delete or move files automatically.

timeline.title: Rule matched
timeline.detail: storage.used_gte_90.v1 evaluated against explicitly synthetic observations. No automated action ran.

cases.title: Repeated DNS lookup failures
cases.summary: Three or more recorded DNS failures occurred while the fixture interface remained up. A resolver problem is a hypothesis; upstream reachability and domain-specific issues remain untested.

evidence.title: Recorded DNS failures
evidence.detail: Synthetic bounded five-minute observation window; no live probes were executed.

evidence.title: Interface state
evidence.detail: A configured interface is reported up; that alone does not prove Internet connectivity.

nextSteps: Verify the scope and timestamp of the recorded DNS failures.
Inspect approved resolver configuration and interface state.
Compare failures against a known approved destination; no network probe runs in this MVP.
Record the observation before proposing configuration changes.

timeline.title: Rule matched
timeline.detail: network.dns_failures_gte_3_link_up.v1 evaluated against explicitly synthetic observations. No automated action ran.

runbooks.title: Service availability

steps: Confirm this service is expected to be running on this endpoint.

Check recent configuration and dependency changes.
Document the finding. Any restart requires separate operator approval.

runbooks.title: Storage pressure
runbooks.description: Confirm filesystem pressure without scanning personal files or deleting data.
steps: Verify the affected local volume and available capacity.
Compare the last samples and confirm whether growth is continuing.
Check approved application retention settings with the owner.
Propose a scoped cleanup; do not delete or move files automatically.

runbooks.title: DNS resolution
runbooks.description: Separate observed lookup failures from transport and configuration hypotheses.
steps: Verify the scope and timestamp of the recorded DNS failures.
Inspect approved resolver configuration and interface state.
Compare failures against a known approved destination; no network probe runs in this MVP.
Record the observation before proposing configuration changes.
